A flourless chocolate cake, set with eggs and a spoonful of ground almonds
icing sugar or edible gold dust

Preheat oven to 180°C (gas mark 4). Line a square or round tin with greaseproof paper — square is easier. Place two strips of paper running from one side to the other in a cross to help lift the cake out (unless using a tin with a removable side).
Melt the chocolate, sugar, salt, and butter in a heatproof bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water. Remove from heat.
Whisk the eggs with the ground almonds until frothy, then fold into the chocolate mixture. It will look like it isn't combining at first — keep going until it thickens and comes together.
Pour into the tin and bake for 35–40 minutes.
Cool slightly in the tin, then dust with icing sugar or gold dust.
The mixture looks split when the eggs first go in. Keep folding until it thickens.
